subject: [PATCH nfs-utils v2 2/7] mountd: prime the kernel caches over netlink on MOUNT

2026-10-19.patch_summary: This patch modifies the mountd service to prime the kernel caches over netlink when a MOUNT request is made, rather than relying on /proc writes. This ensures that export state carried by netlink is not lost when the /proc write replaces it. The patch also updates the nl_add_ip_map function to take an expiry TTL and makes cross-mount submounts use netlink as well.
